name: vod2strm
description: Generate .strm and NFO files for Movies & Series from the Dispatcharr DB, with cleanup and CSV reports.

fields.label: Use Direct URLs
fields.help: Write provider URLs directly instead of Dispatcharr proxy URLs.

fields.label: Max Filesystem Concurrency
fields.help: Maximum concurrent file operations (adaptive throttling will adjust based on NAS performance). Lower values protect slower storage.

fields.label: Adaptive Throttling
fields.help: Automatically reduce concurrency when NAS is slow, increase when fast. Protects against I/O overload.

fields.label: Auto-run after VOD Refresh
fields.help: Automatically generate .strm files after Dispatcharr refreshes VOD content from providers. Uses 30-second debounce to batch multiple refreshes.

fields.label: Dry Run (simulate without writing)
fields.help: Simulate generation without creating/modifying files. Useful for testing.

fields.label: Name Cleaning Regex
fields.help: Optional regex to strip patterns from names (e.g., ^(?:EN|TOP)\s*-\s*). Matches are replaced with empty string.

fields.label: Content Filter: Movie IDs
fields.help: Comma-separated database IDs to include (e.g., '11730,14359'). Leave empty to generate all.

fields.label: Content Filter: Series IDs
fields.help: Comma-separated database IDs to include (e.g., '1521,1797,2736'). Leave empty to generate all.

fields.label: Multi-Provider Mode
fields.help: Generate STRM files for all providers. When disabled, only generates for the highest priority provider.

fields.label: Notify Jellyfin After Generation
fields.help: Trigger a targeted Jellyfin library rescan after .strm files are created or updated. Only fires when files are actually written (not on dry runs or cached skips).

fields.label: Jellyfin URL
fields.help: Jellyfin server base URL (e.g. http://jellyfin:8096). Note: Dispatcharr runs behind gluetun VPN - Docker container names may not resolve. Use the container IP if needed (find it with: docker inspect jellyfin).

fields.label: Jellyfin API Key
fields.help: API key for Jellyfin authentication. Generate one in Jellyfin Dashboard > API Keys.

fields.label: Jellyfin Library Root
fields.help: Path as Jellyfin sees the STRM output (e.g. /media/strm). Remaps Output Root to this path when notifying Jellyfin. Leave blank if both containers mount the same path.
